s.d: action by which humans or deities give information to others to help them exercise their minds to determine how they are going to achieve a particular purpose
a person whose official role and responsibility it is to give advice to someone in authority

man, also known as {L:Israel<SDBH:יִשְׂרָאֵל>} and {L:Jeshurun<SDBH:יְשֻׁרוּן>}; ◄ second son of {L:Isaac<SDBH:יִצְחָק>}; ► one of the patriarchs of {L:Israel<SDBH:יִשְׂרָאֵל>}; in poetic texts often used as a reference to the entire people of Israel
man; ◄ tribe of {L:Simeon<SDBH:שִׁמְעֹון>}
man; ◄ descendant of {L:Seir<SDBH:שֵׂעִיר>}
a large group of trees or shrubs which grow close together and where several wild animals are known to live; ≈ considered to be a dangerous place for humans and domestic animals

s.g: House of the Forest of Lebanon

a mountain between {L:Kiriath-Jearim<SDBH:קִרְיַת יְעָרִים>} and {L:Beth-Shemesh<SDBH:בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ>}
a structure of hexagonal cells of wax, made by bees to store honey and eggs, ► which is eaten, together with the honey; ≈ regarded as sweet and tasty

s.g: House of the Forest of Lebanon

a mountain between {L:Kiriath-Jearim<SDBH:קִרְיַת יְעָרִים>} and {L:Beth-Shemesh<SDBH:בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ>}

man, also known as {L:Jehoaddah<SDBH:יְהֹועַדָּה>}; ◄ son of {L:Ahaz<SDBH:אָחָז>}; tribe of {L:Benjamin<SDBH:בִּנְיָמִן>}
man, also known as {L:Jair<SDBH:יָעִיר>}; ► father of {L:Elhanan<SDBH:אֶלְחָנָן>}, warrior, time of king {L:David<SDBH:דָּוִד>}
man; ◄ son of {L:Jeroham<SDBH:יְרֹחָם>}; family head; tribe of {L:Benjamin<SDBH:בִּנְיָמִן>}
man; ► married a foreign wife; after exile
action by which humans speak without proper reflection ahead of time
exact meaning unknown; probably: = action by which humans ingest liquids in large quantities
action by which humans or animals stop their current or regular activities, ► often with the purpose of recovering their strength
s.g: to wait; to pause; to rest

s.d: literally: to have rest; hence: = state in which an area is unoccupied
literally: to rest; hence: = state in which humans are free from grief, anxiety, worries, and fear
s.g: to have relief; to be at rest

s.d: literally: to give rest; hence: = causative action by which deities cause humans to be free from grief, anxiety, worries, and fear
s.g: to grant relief; to give rest

s.d: literally: to give rest (to an event); hence: = causative process by which a certain attitude reduces the intensity of an event
s.g: to lay to rest; to soothe

s.d: literally: to give rest to (one's) anger; hence: = causative action by which deities cause their anger to subside by punishing those who provoked it
literally: to give rest to (someone's) spirit; hence: = causative action by which humans cause the anger of deities to subside
literally: to find rest; hence: = process by which humans experience peace, without threats from surrounding enemies
s.g: to find rest; to find peace

s.d: literally: to give rest; hence: = causative action by which humans or deities cause (other) humans to experience peace, without threats from surrounding enemies
s.g: to grant rest; to give peace

s.d: literally: to give rest to (one's) place; exact meaning unsure; possibly: = action by which humans stop fulfilling their role and responsibility
literally: to rest; hence: = process by which a moving entity takes position in a certain location

literally: to give rest; hence: = causative action by which humans or deities place (other) humans or inanimate objects in a certain location, often with the intention of leaving them there for an extended period of time
s.g: to put; to place; to set aside; to deposit; to leave

s.d: literally: to rest; hence: = state in which an event is to take place in a certain location, ◄ as if it were physically located there
s.g: to abide; to lodge; to happen; to take place

s.d: literally: to cause to rest; hence: = causative action by which deities cause an event to take place certain location, ◄ as if it were physically located there
s.g: to lay; to cause to happen; to take place

s.d: literally: to leave (something at a certain place); hence: = causative process by which human possessions are transferred to their offspring or their successors when they die
literally: to leave (one's) name (to someone else); hence: = causative process by which the reputation of humans becomes the reason for other humans to engage in a certain activity
literally: to rest (on someone else); hence: = action by which humans attack other humans with overwhelming force
literally: to give rest to (one's) hand; hence: = action by which humans allow their outstretched hand to return to their body, ◄ often as a result of weariness
s.g: to lower (one's) hand; to withdraw (one's) hand

s.d: literally: to withdraw (one's) hand; hence: = action by which humans intentionally refrain from an activity
literally: to give rest; hence: = action by which humans or forces intentionally do not keep (other) humans or deities from carrying out a certain activity
action by which humans leave the road they are travelling on to engage in other activities, often with the purpose to continue on they way later
causative action by which animals force humans to leave the road they are travelling on
s.g: to cause to make a turn

s.d: literally: to make a turn; hence: = action by which humans stop engaging in a certain type of behavior, and start to be involved in other activities, ◄ described as people leaving the road they are travelling on

literally: to cause (someone) to make a turn; hence: = causative action by which humans cause other humans to stop engaging in a certain type of behavior, and start to be involved in other activities, ◄ described as people causing other people to leave the road they are travelling on
s.g: to cause to turn away from

s.d: process by which an object disappears or is removed from its place
s.g: to pass from, to be removed; to depart

s.d: action by which humans or deities leave a certain place
causative action by which humans or deities remove humans or objects from their place
s.g: to remove; to take away; to put away; to cut off

s.d: process by which an event comes to an end, ◄ described as if they are removed from a place
s.g: to pass from, to be removed; to depart; to leave

s.d: causative action by which humans or deities cause an event to come to an end, ◄ described as if someone removes them from their place
causative action by which humans remove other humans from a certain function or position
